items.label: Attendance Entry Update: Overtime (OT) entry is now enabled. Enter OT Hours and OT Minutes in 15-minute intervals (0, 15, 30, 45).
Wage Entry Enhancements: PLI option is now available. System will validate Skill Category and Social Category before saving. Use the WUIN link for quick update of missing details.
Manage Engagements: available under View Active, View Inactive Workmen and Moved Out Workmen. Use this to engage workmen for dates before the last attendance date.
Step 1: Register Workmen — Workmen → Engage Workmen Against Work Order lists all workmen. Use New Workman if a workman is not available.
Step 2: Engage Workmen — use Engage Workmen Against Work Order. Engagement allowed from dates after the last attendance date.
Step 3: Mark Attendance — Attendance → New Attendance. Save attendance for workmen engaged in the period, then submit after verification.
Step 4: Wage Entry — available under New Wage Entry after attendance submission. Verify and submit wage details.
Important: ensure workmen engagement is correct, attendance is submitted before wage entry, and all mandatory workman fields are filled.
